title: Spherical perceptron pressure with orthogonally invariant disorder
exact_target: For $M/N\to \alpha >0$, bi-orthogonally invariant M-by-N disorder whose singular empirical law tends in probability to a compactly supported nu and whose singular values have no outliers from supp(nu), does the bounded-continuous activation pressure converge in probability and mean to a deterministic function of (alpha,nu,f)? Ask for its spectral-block formula obtained by optimizing input squared-norm fractions $\rho _i:$ one-half $sum_i$ $v_i$ $\log (\rho _i/v_i)$, plus alpha times the block spherical-output pressure, then taking spectral mesh to zero.
